answer: Mechanism: Cipher-Crystal Relic Lattice. Each epoch a VRF publishes a crystal seed; an agent submits a cipher proof binding its action to a unique leaf in a sparse Merkle tree salted by a relic nonce. Coordinated agents must reserve adjacent leaves, whose price doubles per occupied sibling. A sybil cluster of k identities pays exponential slot rent, while honest agents amortize one leaf per task. Proofs verify without identity, so the attacker’s marginal cost rises with coordination size.
